labels.reason: Body cells contain Co, T1/2, Vd, Cltot and AUC estimates for six species, with printed animal counts. Notes identify meropenem, a 20 mg/kg single IV bolus, plasma bioassay, study weight ranges and reported compartmental derivation. These support partial requirement matches and source-backed parameter candidates only: LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED. Cltot input coverage remains UNRESOLVED because dose composition and parameter definitions are incomplete. Vd does not establish Vss, and neither printed n nor species-level estimates establishes individual variability. The abstract half-life discrepancy is retained without reconciliation. No model, parameter or species is qualified for human translation.

findings.reason: A25 reports seven abstract half-life numbers for six species and a different species order. C27:C32 contain six table values, including rabbit 20.8. The abstract sequence cannot be assigned unambiguously to the table rows. Both representations are retained as printed.
findings.needed_material: Human review of the exact Table 1 and abstract contexts, with a recorded decision before adopting affected half-life values.

findings.reason: A20 and A22 both state 20 mg/kg IV for this table. A22 additionally specifies meropenem and single IV bolus. These occurrences do not establish separate administrations.
findings.needed_material: Confirm and retain the two source occurrences as duplicate dose statements during preparation.

findings.reason: E27:E32 provide reported Cltot candidates with ml/min/kg units, and A22 supplies a 20 mg/kg single IV bolus. A22 explicitly leaves salt/hydrate basis unstated. Total/free concentration basis, detailed clearance definition, reported uncertainty and the AUC integration window are NOT_FOUND. A24 provides model classes but does not independently validate the estimates.
findings.needed_material: Clarify analyte-specific dose composition, clearance and exposure definitions, estimation context and reported uncertainty before any dependent CL calculation or acceptance; retain the existing estimates as unvalidated literature candidates.

findings.reason: D27:D32 report Vd in ml/kg. The page does not identify Vd as Vss, Vz or Vc and contains no concentration-time or moment data. It therefore does not establish the conditional Vss input requirement.
findings.needed_material: If Vss is selected downstream, obtain a source definition identifying the reported volume or the permitted time-course and input-history evidence needed for that endpoint.

findings.reason: MI014 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk: Support for individual PK variability. A27:A32 supply printed n and the table supplies species-level model-derived estimates, but verified individual records, sampling structure and defined variability are NOT_FOUND on this page. A defensible individual-variability basis for subsequent population predictions has not been established. DRQ09 is not matched as supported variability evidence. This page assessment does not establish the contents of other attachment bodies.
findings.needed_material: During PK work, assess available experimental units and traceable variability evidence; record supported variability or the resulting population-prediction limitation without manufacturing interindividual variability from species-level estimates or group summaries.

findings.reason: Printed animal counts and model classes are available, but the page does not state whether parameters summarize individual fits or arise from another aggregation, nor does it define sampling structure or uncertainty. No digitized curves, SD/SE/CI definitions, detection limits or substituted-limit means are reported here. Their absence from this page does not establish absence elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: Retain the REPORTED_PARAMETER classification and unknown fields during preparation; obtain linked estimation and sampling context before assigning individual or group-summary meaning. Apply DRQ08 only if linked summary or digitized modeling evidence is subsequently established.

findings.reason: A23 provides study-associated weight ranges, strain and sex for six distinct species. Individual weights or a defined scaling weight linked to each estimate and animal health or infection state are NOT_FOUND. Candidate species coverage does not establish qualified translation coverage.
findings.needed_material: Before body-size translation, identify the source-supported weight representation linked to each parameter and clarify animal state; do not replace ranges with computed midpoints or typical weights.

findings.reason: Reported parameter candidates and study weight ranges are available. Binding measurements, renal elimination evidence, justified physiological relationships, supported upstream model outputs and translation uncertainty inputs are NOT_FOUND on this page. Cltot alone does not identify renal clearance.
findings.needed_material: Retain available candidates and obtain the additional inputs required by the translation approach actually considered, together with upstream model assessment and species inclusion/exclusion review.
